questions.question: C’est un ___ appartement.
questions.explanation: Beau, nouveau, vieux have a special form before a masculine noun starting with a vowel or silent h: bel, nouvel, vieil. Feminine: belle, nouvelle, vieille. Here: bel.

questions.question: C’est une ___ maison.
questions.explanation: Beau, nouveau, vieux have a special form before a masculine noun starting with a vowel or silent h: bel, nouvel, vieil. Feminine: belle, nouvelle, vieille. Here: belle.

questions.question: Elle a de ___ yeux.
questions.explanation: Beau, nouveau, vieux have a special form before a masculine noun starting with a vowel or silent h: bel, nouvel, vieil. Feminine: belle, nouvelle, vieille. Here: beaux.

questions.question: C’est mon ___ ordinateur.
questions.explanation: Beau, nouveau, vieux have a special form before a masculine noun starting with a vowel or silent h: bel, nouvel, vieil. Feminine: belle, nouvelle, vieille. Here: nouvel.

questions.question: J’ai une ___ voiture.
questions.explanation: Beau, nouveau, vieux have a special form before a masculine noun starting with a vowel or silent h: bel, nouvel, vieil. Feminine: belle, nouvelle, vieille. Here: nouvelle.

questions.question: C’est un ___ homme.
questions.explanation: Beau, nouveau, vieux have a special form before a masculine noun starting with a vowel or silent h: bel, nouvel, vieil. Feminine: belle, nouvelle, vieille. Here: vieil.

questions.question: Ma grand-mère est ___.
questions.explanation: Beau, nouveau, vieux have a special form before a masculine noun starting with a vowel or silent h: bel, nouvel, vieil. Feminine: belle, nouvelle, vieille. Here: vieille.

questions.question: Elle porte une robe ___.
questions.explanation: This adjective has an irregular feminine form. Here: blanche.

questions.question: Cette route est très ___.
questions.explanation: This adjective has an irregular feminine form. Here: longue.

questions.question: Ma voisine est très ___.
questions.explanation: This adjective has an irregular feminine form. Here: gentille.

questions.question: Cette tarte est vraiment ___.
questions.explanation: This adjective has an irregular feminine form. Here: bonne.

questions.question: La porte est ___.
questions.explanation: The adjective agrees with la porte (feminine singular): ouverte.

questions.question: C’est une histoire ___.
questions.explanation: This adjective has an irregular feminine form. Here: fausse.

questions.question: Ma sœur est ___.
questions.explanation: Adjectives in -eux become -euse in the feminine; the masculine plural stays -eux. Here: heureuse.

questions.question: Ils sont ___ de venir.
questions.explanation: Adjectives in -eux become -euse in the feminine; the masculine plural stays -eux. Here: heureux.

questions.question: Cette rue est ___ la nuit.
questions.explanation: Adjectives in -eux become -euse in the feminine; the masculine plural stays -eux. Here: dangereuse.

questions.question: Elle est très ___.
questions.explanation: Adjectives in -if become -ive in the feminine. Here: sportive.

questions.question: Mes sœurs sont très ___.
questions.explanation: Adjectives in -if become -ive in the feminine. Here: actives.

questions.question: Elle a des chaussures ___.
questions.explanation: Colour words that are also nouns (orange, marron) never change.

questions.question: J’ai deux pulls ___.
questions.explanation: Colour words that are also nouns (orange, marron) never change.

questions.question: Choisis l’ordre correct :
questions.explanation: Most adjectives go after the noun, but short common ones (beau, bon, grand, petit, jeune, vieux, nouveau, joli, mauvais, gros) go before it.

questions.question: Choisis la forme correcte :
questions.explanation: Most adjectives go after the noun, but short common ones (beau, bon, grand, petit, jeune, vieux, nouveau, joli, mauvais, gros) go before it.

questions.question: Choisis la bonne suite : J’ai acheté…
questions.explanation: Colour adjectives always go after the noun: une voiture rouge.

questions.question: C’est un film ___.
questions.explanation: The adjective agrees with un film (masculine singular): intéressant.

questions.question: Ce sont des problèmes ___.
questions.explanation: Adjectives in -al become -aux in the masculine plural, -ales in the feminine plural. Here: internationaux.

questions.question: Ce sont des fêtes ___.
questions.explanation: Adjectives in -al become -aux in the masculine plural, -ales in the feminine plural. Here: nationales.

questions.question: Les ___ jours sont difficiles.
questions.explanation: The adjective agrees with les jours (masculine plural): premiers.

questions.question: C’est ma ___ année à l’université.
questions.explanation: This adjective has an irregular feminine form. Here: première.

questions.question: Elle est ___ de ses résultats.
questions.explanation: This adjective has an irregular feminine form. Here: fière.

questions.question: C’est une idée ___.
questions.explanation: This adjective has an irregular feminine form. Here: folle.
